recent_posts.topic: Attending New York Build 2026 construction show
Service-as-Software replacing SaaS - companies building vs buying, AI enabling internal development
recent_posts.text_preview: Most people agree the golden age of Software-as-a-Service is over. What if the next one is Service-as-Software? Companies don't want to buy more software. The build vs. buy pendulum has swung hard. Most can build what they need themselves now.

recent_posts.topic: GTM Engineering Report - legacy GTM platforms struggling, billion-dollar valuations cut 80%
recent_posts.text_preview: Legacy GTM platforms are struggling. Entire categories getting repriced. Billion-dollar valuations cut by 80%. But who replaces them? Garrett Wolfe just dropped the first real benchmark on that answer. The State of GTM Engineering Report.

recent_posts.topic: Prediction: Sales teams won't log into CRMs in 5 years - CRM becomes infrastructure layer
recent_posts.text_preview: In 5 years, your sales team won't have to log into a CRM. Not because CRMs disappear. But because the CRM becomes something that runs underneath. Like a database.
